install_msg: Create replies with `[p]cc add rules Welcome to the café!` then trigger with `[p]rules`. Help: `[p]cc`.
name: customcommands
description: Create per-guild custom commands triggered by your bot prefix. Add, edit, remove, list, optional embed mode. Does not override real bot commands.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-guild custom command names, response text, optional embed flag, and creator user id.
